references.text: Similar to how Jesus uses parables to convey deeper truths, such as in the Parable of the Sower.
Psalm 78:2 speaks about opening one's mouth in parables, which mirrors Jesus' teaching method in Matthew 13:3.
Isaiah 6:9-10 is referenced by Jesus in Matthew 13 to explain why he uses parables, providing a direct connection to his use of parables in verse 3.
Micah 4:12 speaks about the nations that do not understand God's plans, similar to how Jesus uses parables to hide and reveal truths.
Luke 8:4-15 is the parallel to Matthew 13:3, where Jesus tells the Parable of the Sower and explains it.
Mark 4:10-20 is Mark's version of the Parable of the Sower, offering insight into Jesus' teaching through parables.
